about: In 1947, hard-boiled private eye Ben O'Hara is searching for a missing girl in an abandoned hotel. Investigate room by room, piece together clues, and give the living dead lead poisoning in this noir horror.
-Possibly the scariest and most disturbing game ever created
-Heart-rending Detective Noir Story, guaranteed to traumatize you
-Eerie Original Soundtrack written and performed by the solo developer
-Perma-death (for the protagonist and possibly you, too)
-Loosens your grip on reality and also your bowels
-May summon the recently deceased into your gaming room
summary: In 1947, hard-boiled private eye Ben O'Hara is searching for a missing girl in an abandoned hotel. Investigate room by room, piece together clues, and give the living dead lead poisoning in this noir horror.
